title: Ender-Warped-Blocks
description: This texturepacks makes all Warped forest related blocks dark purple to match the endermen.
body:
Have you ever wondered: "Why are the Warped forests in minecraft cyan (or green idk what color is called) even though the enderman is the main mob that spawns there".

Okay... Maybe you didn't have that question but i sure did and so i created this texturepack to make all the Warped forest related blocks a dark purple to match the enderman.

Note: If you download the universal File dont be mistaken if Minecraft says that the texturepack is made for an older / newer version of Minecraft it will work for 1.16 and all Versions that have been released after 1.16!

Also please let me know in the comments if it doesnt work in a specific version and i'll try to fix it.
